profile.visual_desc: Armored human in olive-grey tunic and baggy blue pants. Features a heavy blue mechanical helmet and massive shoulder-mounted cannon.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Blue metallic helmet with a single glowing red eye lens. Facing right with a cold, robotic appearance.
profile.weapon_desc: Large blue shoulder-mounted energy launcher held with both hands.
profile.step1_ready: Isometric ↘ stance; the unit braces the heavy launcher on the right shoulder, facing the target.
profile.step2_windup: Leans forward as the cannon muzzle charges with a bright yellow glow.
profile.step3_impact: Fires a thick, straight yellow energy beam projecting downward-right from the muzzle.
profile.step4_finish: Holds the firing recoil stance while the beam curves and dissipates into a fading trail.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The straight energy beam in Frame 4 perfectly aligns with the cannon barrel's orientation toward the bottom-right.

evaluation.diagnosis: The sequence effectively mirrors the reference wind-up and firing logic. VFX alignment and character orientation remain stable.
